scripts.build:release: set -a && . ./.env.local && set +a && CI=true tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles dmg && DMG=$(ls -t src-tauri/target/universal-apple-darwin/release/bundle/dmg/*.dmg | head -1) && xcrun notarytool submit "$DMG" --key "$APPLE_API_KEY_PATH" --key-id "$APPLE_API_KEY" --issuer "$APPLE_API_ISSUER" --wait && xcrun stapler staple "$DMG"
